name: @wahidgroup/tightbeam-ws-workspace
description: Workspace root for the tightbeam-ws TypeScript packages (shared typing, frame builder, and browser client).

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @wahidgroup/typing-ts && npm run build --workspace @wahidgroup/tightbeam-ts && npm run build --workspace @wahidgroup/tightbeam-ws-client
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @wahidgroup/typing-ts && npm run test --workspace @wahidgroup/tightbeam-ts
